from pathlib import Path
import json,hashlib
rt=Path.home()/'.local/share/prediction-project-executor/campaigns/FULL-A2Z-LIVE-20261004-V4'
old=json.loads((rt/'requests'/'A2Z-V4-ASTRA-PREBUILD-DIRECT-20261007-R4P2.json').read_text())
req=json.loads(Path('control/model_execution/direct_requests/A2Z-V4-SOL-PROPOSAL-DIRECT-20261008-R5P1.json').read_text())
res=json.loads(Path('control/model_execution/direct_results/A2Z-V4-SOL-PROPOSAL-DIRECT-20261008-R5P1.json').read_text())
proposal=json.loads(res['final'])
assert req['task_id']==res['task_id']=='A2Z-V4-SOL-PROPOSAL-DIRECT-20261008-R5P1'
assert req['binding_sha256']==res['binding_sha256'] and req['input_sha256']==res['input_sha256']
assert res['model']=='gpt-5.6-sol' and res['execution_layer']=='DIRECT_SOL_CHAT' and res['codex'] is False
assert proposal['proposal_version']==5 and proposal['scientific_status']=='NO_PROVEN_EDGE'
out=dict(old)
out['task_id']='A2Z-V4-ASTRA-PREBUILD-DIRECT-20261008-R5P1'
out['route_task_id']='SESSION-ROUTE-246799adf99f0bf8336c27a0'
payload={'candidate_id':req['candidate_id'],'campaign_id':req['campaign_id'],'proposal_task_id':req['task_id'],'proposal_binding_sha256':req['binding_sha256'],'proposal_input_sha256':req['input_sha256'],'proposal_completion_sha256':res['completion_sha256'],'proposal':proposal,'scientific_status':'NO_PROVEN_EDGE','safety':{'live_trading':False,'paid_actions':False,'wallet_actions':False}}
prefix=str(old['prompt']).split('INPUT_JSON:',1)[0]+'INPUT_JSON:'
out['prompt']=prefix+json.dumps(payload,sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':'))
out['input_sha256']=hashlib.sha256(out['prompt'].encode()).hexdigest()
if 'binding_sha256' in out: out['binding_sha256']=hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(payload,sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':')).encode()).hexdigest()
assert out['phase']=='ASTRA_PREBUILD'
assert out.get('model_policy')=='ASTRA_EXACT' or out.get('target_model') in ('gpt-6-astra','GPT-6 Astra')
assert out['live_trading'] is False and out['paid_actions'] is False and out['wallet_actions'] is False
Path('control/dev_checks/r5p1_astra_request_n1e134.json').write_text(json.dumps(out,indent=2,sort_keys=True)+'\n')
print('R5P1_ASTRA_REQUEST_READY')
